claim_ceiling: seed-authority registration only; binds the draw grammar and its root identity. It draws no replicate, certifies nothing, admits nothing, opens no window-2 value, and is not a power result; Lambda_geo INCONCLUSIVE

grammar.master_rule: one master numpy PCG64 Generator per (authority, family), seeded with that substream seed
grammar.replicate_rule: replicate r's seed = the r-th sequential int64 draw of that master: master.integers(0, 2**63, size=r+1, dtype=int64)[r] -- sequential, so replicate r is only defined relative to the same master stream

grammar_evidence.method: master + first 3 replicate seeds per family, computed through the REGISTERED entrypoint at the carrier commit (never re-implemented here); a verifier rebuilding this record recomputes them, so any drift in the root, the engine module, or the entrypoint refuses

prohibitions: never hash the current clock, the target commit, or the capsule to obtain a seed
never accept a caller-supplied 64-hex seed authority: the geometry validator requires this record's exact root, resolved from its manifest pin

root_source.identity_rule: LF-normalized sha256 of the committed blob at the registered root commit; the frozen commit is required to be an ancestor of the carrier

ruling_basis: codex w2r1 pre-fire ruling 2026-08-31T15:07Z item 3 (CRITICAL): the seed authority is the already-frozen Amendment-2 root, not a new choice; the geometry lane must resolve it from this manifest-pinned record rather than accept any 64-hex caller value

target_identity.rule: every consumed implementation's source must equal its bytes AT THE NAMED TARGET, and every registered steering constant re-derived from the target source by AST must equal the live runtime value; otherwise the build REFUSES rather than producing target-labelled output built from other code
